frūstrā

adverb

in vain, without success

In this lexicon

  • fail

    also used · classical · Phaedr. 1.26.10: quae cum lagōnae collum frūstrā lamberet

Examples

  • quae cum lagōnae collum frūstrā lamberet, peregrīnam sīc locūtam volucrem accēpimus: sua quisque exempla dēbet aequō animō patī

    As the fox licked the neck of the jar in vain, the stranger bird, so we are told, said: “Everyone should bear patiently being treated as he treats others.”Phaedr. 1.26.10–12
